name: LXR-02
summary: Six-voice drum synthesizer. Erica Synths published its firmware and bootloader source under GPL-3.0 in October 2026. Modwerk has no base or mods for it yet.

research.label: erica-synths/lxr-desktop-app
research.note: GPL-3.0-only. The STM32F765 firmware: voices, FX, sequencer, MIDI, SD storage and UI, with CMake, Arm GCC and the SD-card update image tool.

research.label: erica-synths/lxr-desktop-bootloader
research.note: GPL-3.0-only. The SD-card updater in flash sector 0, which firmware updates never change.

research.label: Erica Synths: LXR-02 goes open source
research.note: The release announcement. Erica Synths supports only its own firmware; modified firmware is installed at the owner's risk.
